text: The historical final-page branch tests the currentChanges array itself rather than its length. An empty array remains truthy, so this branch can use at(-1) with no last change when building a token. The initial create-batching test does not exercise an empty incremental continuation. The accepted later mock obtains nextOffset from getChanges instead; that helper was not audited here, so this does not claim a reproduced failure or a fully verified current cure.
title: The initial Graph mock has a separate empty-page token edge
